summary: The creator demonstrates a Thunderbolt team against the Season 8 endgame boss, Lv. 260 Mekkatorque. The setup achieves over 1.25 billion total damage over a 7-minute fight. Perkunte serves as the primary carry, accounting for nearly 75% of the total output. Complete hero equipment, stat sheets, and skill timings (all set to default) are displayed at the conclusion of the battle.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Dealt 932.4 million damage (74.6% of the team's total) against Mekkatorque.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Contributed 184.7 million damage (14.8% of team output) via electricity buildup and Lightning Chains.

heroes.name: Shai'nachtan
heroes.note: Provided buffs, enhanced Lightning Chains, and dealt 122.8 million damage.

heroes.name: Alaura
heroes.note: Enhanced Lightning Chains and dealt 28.6 million damage.

heroes.name: Nathaniel
heroes.note: Kept the team alive for the full encounter by cleansing debuffs and providing shields.

teams.note: Scored 1,250,403,658 total damage using full auto with default skill timings.

tips: This Thunderbolt team composition can be run entirely on default auto skill timings against Mekkatorque.
Build Nathaniel with enough skill haste and enlightenment to maintain shield uptime against Mekkatorque's heavy attacks.
title: Thunderbolt vs Mekkatorque (Phase 1) | Endgame Boss | Season 8 | Dragonheir
